item.summary: Updates from the evening session in Birmingham Hudson-Smith surges to 400m gold | Mail Luke Matt Hudson-Smith is having a chat with the BBC about his 400m triumph last night . He had no sleep at all overnight. “I tried to sleep, I was just staring at the wall,” he says. “So many flashbacks, so many memories … it was so surreal … I did it. Continue reading...
